Monitor(A="c:/Program Files (x86)/World of Warcraft/_classic_era_/Interface/AddOns"
D="f:/Game Development/WoWAPITesting"
snap() {
  find "$A" -maxdepth 3 \( -name HARNESS_CONTRACT.md -o -name AUDIT.md -o -name DEPENDENCY_CONTRACTS.md \) -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null
  find "$D/docs/contracts" "$D/README.md" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.md' -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null
  find "$D/env" -maxdepth 2 -name '*.lua' -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null
}
prev=$(snap)
while true; do
  sleep 20
  cur=$(snap) || continue
  [ "$cur" = "$prev" ] && continue
  comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$prev" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$cur" | sort) 2>/dev/null \
    | sed -e "s#^[0-9.]* ##" -e "s#$A/##" -e "s#$D/##" -e 's#/Tests/HARNESS_CONTRACT.md##' \
    | while read -r f; do [ -n "$f" ] && echo "CHANGED: $f"; done
  prev=$cur
done)
